owner_decision.statement: The Owner decided on 2026-10-08 to release 1.5.5. Stable 1.5.3 is published for all 44 fixed-group packages: authenticated registry census on 2026-10-05 observed latest 1.5.3 and rc 1.5.0-rc.2 after the v1.5.3 publication from main 2505251f883283908056cd1a8fa031d6bb8f33c5. The historical 1.5.1, 1.5.2 and 1.5.4 candidates were never published; 1.5.4 carried the DEVAI 2.3.0 adoption after its marker and is superseded. One changeset pending on origin/main (the @stynx-nyx/pdf handlebars patch) advances the fixed group from 1.5.4 to 1.5.5 under scripts/version-packages.mjs, and the candidate ships with the first measured DEVAI scorecard. Publish only with the latest dist-tag and an action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt; preflight latest must remain 1.5.3 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. This decision does not authorize angular-profile 2.0.0 remediation.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified stable 1.5.5 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.5.5, rc remains at 1.5.0-rc.2, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history.
